snippet.title: Dark Atlas: Infernum | Horror Game Awards SUMMER SHOWCASE WORLD PREMIERE TRAILER 2025
snippet.description:
If hell is a state of the soul, these are the steps that will lead you to its gates. Dark Atlas: Infernum is a disturbing first-person story where an esoteric end of the world meets psychological survival horror with a strong narrative component.

STEAM LINK: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2089630/Dark_Atlas_Infernum/#:~:text=Dark%20Atlas%3A%20Infernum%20is%20a,with%20a%20strong%20narrative%20component.

#thehorrorgameawards #HorrorGamesShowcase

---

The Horror Game Awards started towards the end of 2022 as a Horror Game of the Year Award set up by two die hard horror game fans. Fourteen content creators made up that year’s jury. It was such a success that in 2023 the jury doubled in size and the awards expanded their scope.

The aim of the awards is simple: to celebrate horror as one of the best genres in video games and to recognise the year’s greatest horror games alongside the developers who make them.
